titulo: Tomorrow's pages, waiting on the chair
caption:
Tomorrow's pages, waiting on the chair

Tomorrow's pages start tonight. The book is already on the chair, so reading is the easy option.

A book on the shelf is a plan, and a book on the chair is an invitation that is hard to walk past.

For whoever puts the book on the chair before the evening starts.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a wooden chair on the right and a thick blue book lying on the floor at the left. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up with narrowed eyes, then its eyes go wide, it leans and the book slides across the floor and up onto the chair seat. A bubble says tonight., the book opens and a page turns. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me leaving the book where I will sit.
